name: github-agent-access-governance-kit
purpose: Provide a PDR, governance controls, policy config, and broker scaffold for safe AI agent access to GitHub repositories.

contents.pdr: Product/design record for the GitHub App access broker.
contents.governance: Best practices, permission matrix, risk register, controls checklist.
contents.config: Example agent, repo, and permission profile policy files.
contents.broker: Minimal Python policy engine and token issuer scaffold.
contents.workflows: GitHub Actions examples for app token and PR validation.
contents.security: Threat model and secret handling policy.

deployment: Enable read-only agents before write agents
repair_guidance: If tests fail, inspect config YAML and branch prefix rules.
If token issuance fails, verify app ID, private key, installation ID, and permissions.
If unwanted access occurs, suspend app installation and rotate private key.
references: GitHub Docs: GitHub Apps installation access tokens
GitHub Docs: GitHub Apps vs OAuth Apps
